agent.finish_summary: Fixed IndexError regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py _process_case: changed `first = next(cond[1].flatten())` to `first = next(cond[0].flatten())` since `cond` is a list of condition tokens and index 1 could be out of range for single-token conditions. Verified fix resolves crashes for CASE/WHEN reindent formatting (including compact mode) via manual sqlparse.format() tests; no functional regressions observed in other reindent behaviors tested (multi-WHEN, CASE with input expr, wrap_after, general compact formatting).
